# tablemaker

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of tablemaker is to load the data and make the calculations for the UI Table Maker of Project X

## Installation

You can install the released version of tablemaker from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org) with:

``` r
install.packages("tablemaker")
```

And the development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("randrescastaneda/tablemaker")
```
## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(tablemaker)

## basic example code
tm_load(country = "COL", year = 2014)
```
